info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Institution Login Data Access Tiers API
info.description: The Institution Login Data Access Tiers API enables clients to establish or modify data access tiers for specific accounts linked to an institution login. By utilizing this endpoint, users can tailor access levels for customer accounts, ensuring appropriate data security and compliance. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and service integrators seeking to customize user access based on varying levels of data sensitivity. Typical consumers include developers working on banking applications and data management tools.

post.summary: Create a Data Access Tier for a specific Institution Login
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new data access tier associated with a specific institution login under a customer. This is part of managing access controls for the accounts linked to the institution.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve data access tiers for a specific account under a given customer and institution login. Ensure that the request conforms to the required schema for successful processing.
